integrity: The written all-parameter proof supplies the reasoning; a standard-library exact rational checker verifies 86 graphs and 1572 columns and 38 separate family instances. Finitary computational checks are not substituted for universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Real unweighted complete multipartite graphs with at least three nonempty parts; canonical Euclidean-orthogonal cut and cycle projections only. Cycle maximizers are given by an exact score selection, not a universal size-ranking rule. No nonorthogonal, weighted, or arbitrary-graph claim; independent audit has not occurred.
title: Endpoint cut–cycle norms of complete multipartite graphs and a maximizing-edge reversal
